slides.title: Overview of ZOLLER: Our Expert Knowledge

blocks.body:
With our products, our machines, and our software, we help you accelerate your processes and produce less waste.

We develop solutions tailored to your challenges. Learn more about the options our software and devices open up for you here.

blocks.header:
Presetting & Measuring

Save costs and increase safety with tool default settings
blocks.body:
In order to manufacture parts with precision, modern CNC machine tools require exact tool geometry data. With the tool presetter, you can determine the tool data outside of the machine, saving a lot of setup time. When the tool is inserted, you can immediately import the tool data from the tool presetter. The data transfer to the machine is performed electronically and is therefore completely error-free, as typing errors and transmission errors are eliminated.

Learn more about presetting and measuring machines for tool adjustment

blocks.header:
Tool Management

Good reasons to produce in a more economically efficient manner
blocks.body:
• Reduce setup times: The right tool is always in the right place at the right time. Data output in controller format avoids input errors on the machine and the resulting costs.
  • Find instead of search: You always know which tools are available for which machines and where they
    are located.
  • Better organization: Planned processes with calculable cycle times and efficient checks ensure efficient process management and thus short response times. Autonomous production units can be integrated and organized.
  • Avoid machine downtime: All tools are always available, 24 hours a day. Using the correct tools on the machines prevents collisions and avoids tool breakage.
  • Guarantee quality: High system availability and transparent, stable production processes guarantee the highest quality.
  • Save storage costs: You can see which tools are used how often and order only what is actually needed.
  • Exploit tool potential: Optimal cutting speeds and feeds increase tool life.
  • Increase productivity: Optimized tool circulation ensures short lead times and fully utilized machines, increasing productivity and reducing manufacturing costs.

Economical tool management
Efficient stock management and production data management

blocks.header:
Data Transfer

Secure and fast data transfer
blocks.body:
Data exchange between individual production elements is essential for modern industrial manufacturing. ZOLLER software solutions guarantee fast, reliable transmission of tool data at all times – regardless of manufacturer or platform.

Transmission of tool data
Perfect tool management and production organization

blocks.header:
Inspection & Measuring

Measuring machines ensure precise manufacturing
blocks.body:
In order for tools to do exactly what they were constructed to do, they must be manufactured with precision. With our universal measuring machines, tools can be measured with micrometer accuracy and checked to ensure they correspond to the requirements.

Greater precision thanks to measuring machines

blocks.header:
Automation

Automation solution for tool measurement
blocks.body:
Whether in the tool grinding shop or when preparing, providing, and setting up tools, automating daily tasks will be the answer to this challenge. ZOLLER provides the right solution for automated tool handling for every task. Depending on the requirements, the solution can lie in a closed system with additional modules, a complex automation concept, or collaborative robot support in the tool room.

Everything about modular automation for cutting tools

blocks.header:
Tool Heat Shrink Technology

Short setup times thanks to the use of a shrink device
blocks.body:
For many drilling and milling tools, tool shrink fitting is the fastest and most precise method of clamping the tool. With a suitable shrink station, the necessary step|work sequences can be carried out easily; a shrink fitting machine can automate these steps to a large extent and at the same time guarantee process reliability through appropriate measurements.

The advantages of tool shrink-fitting

blocks.header:
Tool Balancing Technology

Balancing grinding wheels and tools? Important and simple!
blocks.body:
Finely balanced tools are extremely important for modern cutting machines. Unbalances in grinding wheels, in your tools, and in tool systems cause wear and tear or even damage to spindles and motors—not to mention rejects in the workpieces. Regular balancing prevents downtime, ensures quality, and reduces your overall costs.

Our balancing system increases tool life
Smoother running and higher machining performance thanks to balanced grinding wheels

columns.header: Optimize the tool life of your cutting tools
columns.body:
The longer the tool life of a cutting tool, the lower the cost of this tool and the more effectively it can work. If you know the most important factors that influence tool life, it is easier to optimize them.

How you can check and optimize the tool life of your tool

Nowadays, almost no machine or system manufactures just one product—they are usually converted for different products as required. This results in setup times during which the machine generally produces nothing.

Why optimize setup time?
